$schema.description: The JSON schema this file follows, for editors.

model.description: The model sessions start on, as "provider:model" or a model on the profile's provider.

active_profile.description: The profile in profiles/<name>.json to use.

effort.description: How sessions think: off, auto (the model's default), on, or an effort level from low to max. /effort sets it.

endpoint.description: Where Ollama listens. Defaults to http://localhost:11434.

base_url.description: Where Ollama listens, used in place of endpoint when both are set.

num_ctx.description: The context window Ollama allocates for every request.

api_key.description: A key stored in the file. Prefer key_env_var, so the key stays out of files.

key_env_var.description: The environment variable holding the key.

key_env_var.description: The environment variable holding the key.

typesafe.description: TypeSafe, whose Jev judgment model can screen tool output as trust.model "typesafe:jev-latest". Not a chat provider.

api_key.description: A key stored in the file. Prefer key_env_var, so the key stays out of files.

key_env_var.description: The environment variable holding the key.

referer.description: Sent as HTTP-Referer, for OpenRouter attribution.

title.description: Sent as X-Title, for OpenRouter attribution.

id.description: The provider name models are addressed by, as in "id:model".

dialect.description: The wire format. Defaults to openai.

api_key.description: A key stored in the file. Prefer key_env_var, so the key stays out of files.

key_env_var.description: The environment variable holding the key.

endpoints.description: Other OpenAI or Anthropic compatible endpoints.

api_registry.description: Where each provider is and how to authenticate to it.

context_window.description: Tokens the model accepts in one request.

max_output.description: Most tokens the model writes in one reply.

models.description: Facts about models, keyed "provider:model", overriding what providers report.

allow.description: Rules that allow a call without asking, such as "run_command(npm test *)". Lists from every layer apply.

ask.description: Rules that ask before a call, such as "run_command(npm test *)". Lists from every layer apply.

deny.description: Rules that refuse a call; a deny always wins, such as "run_command(npm test *)". Lists from every layer apply.

mode.description: The mode a session starts in.

enabled.description: On by default wherever a sandbox works.

network.description: Let sandboxed commands reach the network. Off by default.

writable.description: Directories besides the project and the temporary directory that commands may write.

hidden.description: Paths hidden from commands in addition to the defaults.

env.description: How much of the environment commands and servers inherit.

env_passthrough.description: Variables passed to every process by name.

max_steps.description: Model requests per user turn before the loop stops.

max_tool_calls_per_turn.description: Tool calls per turn; 0 means no cap beyond the step limit.

tool_result_max_chars.description: Characters of one tool result kept in context.

max_output_tokens.description: Output tokens to ask for per reply, capped by the model's own limit.

enabled.description: The lsp tool and diagnostics after edits. On by default, for the servers that are installed.

diagnostics_after_edit.description: Tell the model about errors the language server finds in a file it just changed. On by default.

extensions.description: File extensions it serves, without the dot.

servers.description: Language servers by name. A name used by a default (typescript, python, go, rust) replaces it.

endpoint.description: The provider API endpoint. The built-in LangSearch endpoint is used when omitted.

api_key.description: The key itself. Used only when the declared variable is not set.

key_env_var.description: The environment variable holding the key. Read first.

providers.description: Search providers by name. A name used by a built-in (langsearch) replaces it.

threshold.description: Offer MCP tools through search_tools once the servers bring more than this many. 0 always sends them all. Defaults to 40.

auto_compact.description: Summarize older turns when a request nears the model's window. On by default.

effort.description: How hard the model thinks, where it takes a level.

categories.description: Model chains by name, loaded as agents with no description or rules. Agent files in .jamcli/agents/ describe them.

max_depth.description: How deep tasks may nest: a task started by a task counts one deeper. Defaults to 2.

max_concurrent.description: Tasks one session may run at once. Defaults to 5.

max_turns_per_child.description: Turns a task may take; a task call may ask for fewer, never more. Defaults to 16.

default_agent.description: The agent a task call that names none runs on.

enabled.description: false turns the trust gate off in every mode. It screens only in auto mode, and only once trust.model names a classifier.

model.description: The classifier, as provider:model on any configured provider, or typesafe:jev-latest. Nothing is chosen for you.

threshold.description: Relevance below which a result is withheld as not relevant; 0 keeps every result that is not an injection. Defaults to 0.3.

dedupe.description: Send identical results to the classifier once, each duplicate taking its twin's verdict. On by default.

trust.description: The classifier that screens tool output before the model reads it, in auto mode.

telemetry.description: The legacy interface's telemetry switch. Traces are sent only when otel.enabled is true.

enabled.description: Send traces to an OpenTelemetry collector. Off by default: nothing leaves the machine unless this is true.

endpoint.description: The OTLP/HTTP traces URL. Defaults to OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT, OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT, then http://localhost:4318/v1/traces.

headers.description: Headers sent with every export, such as a collector token.

include_content.description: Put prompts, outputs, tool arguments, and tool results on spans. Off by default.

matcher.description: For pre_tool and post_tool: a rule such as run_command(git push*) or edit. Every call when absent.

command.description: Run with /bin/sh (cmd.exe on Windows), reading the event as JSON on standard input.

timeout_ms.description: Stop it and report a failure after this long. Defaults to 30000.

enabled.description: false keeps it here without running it.

session_end.description: Commands run when a session ends.

hooks.description: Commands run at lifecycle events. Exit 0 continues, exit 2 blocks with standard error as the reason. A project's hooks run only once trusted.

attribution.description: A trailer added to every commit JamCLI makes, such as "Co-authored-by: ...". Off by default: commits carry only your own identity.

allow_commit_in_bypass.description: Let bypass mode commit without asking. Off by default: a commit is always asked for, whatever the mode.

theme.description: The interface's colors. NO_COLOR forces monochrome. Defaults to dark.

screen_reader.description: Draw the interface as plain labeled lines, with no boxes, marks, or animation. --screen-reader turns it on for one run.

reduced_motion.description: Stop the spinner and shimmer. On by itself in screen reader mode.

thinking_lines.description: How many lines tall the live thinking window is. It keeps that height while the model thinks, so the transcript does not jump. Defaults to 3.

thinking_width.description: How many columns wide the live thinking window is, narrowed when the terminal is narrower. Defaults to 72.

status_text_style.description: How the working indicator's words are lit: glow, mono, aurora, rainbow, minimal, or custom:<name>. Defaults to glow.

status_spinner_style.description: The working indicator's spinner: pulse, bloom, orbit, quad, classic, or custom:<name>. Defaults to pulse.

path.description: A JSON file with label, shimmerColors (the words' ramp from resting to lit), shimmer, spinnerFrames, spinnerColors (the ramp the spinner breathes through), and spinnerIntervalMs. A color is hex, or a theme role: text, dim, accent, warn, or error.

custom_status_styles.description: Styles of your own, by name, each read from a JSON file. Name one as custom:<name>.

ui.description: How the interface looks and moves.
